sql: SELECT s.hospital, count(*) AS rows_checked, sum(CASE WHEN p.ndc11 IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS no_fda_product, sum(CASE WHEN p.ndc11 IS NOT NULL AND s.pkg_units <> 1 AND s.pkg_units <> p.units_per_pkg THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pkg_count_differs, sum(CASE WHEN p.ndc11 IS NOT NULL AND s.unit <> 'each' AND p.pkg_unit <> s.unit THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unit_differs FROM (SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_general UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_east UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_lakeside) s LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = s.ndc11 GROUP BY s.hospital ORDER BY s.hospital
